paragraphs.text:
Carl: Hi. My name's Carl. Nice to meet you.
Pancho: Nice to meet you, too. My name is Francisco.
Carl: What?
Pancho: Francisco, but all my friends and family back in Italy call me Pancho.
Carl:Okay, Pancho. So, tell me something about your family?
Pancho: Well, I have seven brothers and six sisters.
Carl:Wow. That is a big family. So are you the oldest, Pancho?
Pancho : No. I'm the second oldest in my family.
Carl: So, what do your parents do?
Pancho: My father is a taxi driver in Rome, Italy. It's a hard job, but he works hard to support the family.
Carl: How about your mother?
Pancho : She helps run a small family store with some of my brothers and sisters.
Carl: What kind of store?
Pancho: We mainly sell food, like bread, eggs, soft drinks, rice, sugar, and cookies. Things that people buy every day.

My name is Michael. I have a mum and a dad and a brother, and all four of us live in a house. My dad is really
tall. He has brown hair, and he has blue eyes, and that's where I get my blue eyes. My mum is really short. She has
blond hair, and that's where I get my blond hair. My brother is fourteen-years old, and he'll be going into ninth
grade this year, and his name is David. We get along pretty well most of the time. Those are the people I live with.
